q1_issues.issue: "record" is an act, not a stative psych/perception verb, so its transitive subject must be Agent, not Experiencer.
The direct object of "recorded the incident" gets no role atom on the record event — its slot is taken by a sealed proposition, and sealing is licensed only for a finite clausal complement.

"No wraith emerged" carries the explicit quantifier "no", which routes to the strength-0 distributing rule plus a mandatory (QuantifierPhrase wraith emerge "no") companion; the parse uses a single-witness denial bundle and emits no companion, collapsing quantifier-none into plain "a wraith did not emerge".
"within the hour" in sentence 4 is dropped entirely, so the relighting is asserted with no temporal bound at all.
"relit" is lemmatized to `light` with an added (Again …) tag, stripping a derivational prefix that the lemmatization rule says to keep (inflection only, never derivation).

q2_gaps: classificatory "V NP as NP/ADJ" secondary predicate ("recorded the incident as a minor weather event") — not a resultative (nothing changes) and not a depictive; no licensed carrier for the as-phrase
forward bounded window ("within the hour", "within two days") — WithinLast is backward-only, TimeAtMost needs a time term, and BeforeBy states an exact gap rather than a bound
prefixal derivation on a verb ("relit", "reopen") — the instruction set does not say whether the lemma is `relight` or `light` + (Again …)
quantity/portion of-phrase ("a gust of wind", the "a cup of water" case) — explicitly excluded from Possession and not a stated-proportion partitive, so no head is assigned
mandative subjunctive complement ("recommended that the Council issue …") — sealed as a plain proposition, and the directive force has no carrier (Directive/Forbid are imperative-only)

a definite superordinate NP anaphoric to a previously described event ("the incident" for the whole lantern episode) — the anaphoric-definite rule covers re-mention of a same-class witness, not a summary label
ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 410 of Year 2") — (Day n) is defined as the day slot of a calendar date, so (Day 410) overloads it
notes: Coreference across the passage is handled well (the lantern, the gust, and "the recommendation" → the recommend event), as is the sealed recommendation, whose Possession restrictor and per-member wind_exposed rule correctly stay inside the seal while the group typing, the Cliff Path name and the mire_essence genus project. The negated position atom (Past (LocatedIn …)) at strength 0.0 is also the right shape.
